Data

raw <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = "Trials")

attn <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = participants_sheet) %>%
  mutate(
    attentionCheckCorrect = as.numeric(attentionCheckCorrect),
    attentionCheckTotal = as.numeric(attentionCheckTotal),
    accuracy_pct = 100 * attentionCheckCorrect / attentionCheckTotal,
    passed = !is.na(attentionCheckTotal) &
             attentionCheckTotal >= min_checks &
             accuracy_pct >= min_accuracy_pct
  )

model_dat <- raw %>%
  filter(rowKey %in% attn$rowKey[attn$passed],
         block %in% blocks_to_use) %>%
  mutate(
    participant = factor(prolificPID),
    delay_ms = as.numeric(delay_ms),
    causal_rating = as.numeric(causal_rating),
    group = case_when(
      condition == "intact" ~ "Agent",
      scrambled_version == "C" ~ "Object_fixed",
      scrambled_version == "D" ~ "Object_random",
      TRUE ~ "Object_other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(participant, condition, group, delay_ms, causal_rating) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  droplevels()

model_dat %>% distinct(participant, condition) %>% count(condition)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   condition     n

model_dat %>% distinct(participant, group) %>% count(group)

##   <chr>         <int>
## 1 Agent            10
## 2 Object_fixed      2
## 3 Object_other      4
## 4 Object_random     2

Main analysis

main_dat <- model_dat %>%
  mutate(condition_f = factor(condition, levels = c("scrambled", "intact")))

model_same <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    condition_f +
    s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = main_dat,
  method = "ML"
)
## Warning in gam.side(sm, X, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5): model has repeated
## 1-d smooths of same variable.
model_diff <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    condition_f +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition_f, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = main_dat,
  method = "ML"
)

summary(model_same)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## causal_rating ~ condition_f + s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, 
##     participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                   Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)         51.985      5.756   9.031   <2e-16 ***
## condition_fintact   19.791      7.723   2.563    0.011 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:

## s(delay_ms)              7.343  8.274  5.621 1.31e-06 ***

## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.829   Deviance explained = 87.3%
## -ML =   1330  Scale est. = 173.58    n = 306
summary(model_diff)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## causal_rating ~ condition_f + s(delay_ms, by = condition_f, k = k_delay) + 
##     s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                   Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)         51.985      5.759   9.027   <2e-16 ***
## condition_fintact   19.791      7.726   2.562   0.0111 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                                     edf Ref.df     F p-value    
## s(delay_ms):condition_fscrambled  7.371  8.308 8.725  <2e-16 ***
## s(delay_ms):condition_fintact     1.927  2.191 1.791   0.177    
## s(delay_ms,participant)          64.975 88.000 8.515  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.826   Deviance explained = 86.9%
## -ML = 1323.7  Scale est. = 176.16    n = 306
compareML(model_same, model_diff)
## model_same: causal_rating ~ condition_f + s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, 
##     participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## model_diff: causal_rating ~ condition_f + s(delay_ms, by = condition_f, k = k_delay) + 
##     s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Chi-square test of ML scores
## -----
##        Model    Score Edf Difference    Df p.value Sig.
## 1 model_same 1330.029   6                              
## 2 model_diff 1323.723   8      6.306 2.000   0.002  ** 
## 
## AIC difference: -3.75, model model_same has lower AIC.
gam.check(model_same)

## 
## Method: ML   Optimizer: outer newton
## full convergence after 7 iterations.
## Gradient range [-1.173248e-05,3.550222e-06]
## (score 1330.029 & scale 173.5795).
## Hessian positive definite, eigenvalue range [1.722654,159.0754].
## Model rank =  101 / 101 
## 
## Basis dimension (k) checking results. Low p-value (k-index<1) may
## indicate that k is too low, especially if edf is close to k'.
## 
##                            k'   edf k-index p-value
## s(delay_ms)              9.00  7.34    1.02    0.71
## s(delay_ms,participant) 90.00 70.10    1.02    0.64
gam.check(model_diff)

## 
## Method: ML   Optimizer: outer newton
## full convergence after 6 iterations.
## Gradient range [-6.070167e-07,2.749807e-07]
## (score 1323.723 & scale 176.157).
## Hessian positive definite, eigenvalue range [0.3195453,158.0879].
## Model rank =  110 / 110 
## 
## Basis dimension (k) checking results. Low p-value (k-index<1) may
## indicate that k is too low, especially if edf is close to k'.
## 
##                                     k'   edf k-index p-value
## s(delay_ms):condition_fscrambled  9.00  7.37    0.99    0.43
## s(delay_ms):condition_fintact     9.00  1.93    0.99    0.44
## s(delay_ms,participant)          90.00 64.97    0.99    0.47
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(-1000, 1000, length.out = 300),
  condition_f = levels(main_dat$condition_f),
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)
newdat$condition_f <- factor(newdat$condition_f, levels = levels(main_dat$condition_f), ordered = is.ordered(main_dat$condition_f))
if (is.ordered(newdat$condition_f)) contrasts(newdat$condition_f) <- "contr.treatment"

pred <- predict(model_same, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(delay_ms,participant)")
newdat$fit <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)

obs <- main_dat %>%
  group_by(condition_f, delay_ms) %>%
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(causal_rating), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(newdat, aes(x = delay_ms, y = fit, color = condition_f, fill = condition_f)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = delay_ms, y = mean_rating, color = condition_f),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_main, labels = labels_main) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_main, labels = labels_main) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Temporal delay (ms)", y = "Causal judgment", color = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Option 3: same-shape model")

newdat <- expand.grid(

Exploratory analysis: OBJECT-fixed vs. OBJECT-random

expl_dat <- model_dat %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Agent", "Object_fixed", "Object_random")) %>%
  droplevels()

expl_dat %>% distinct(participant, group) %>% count(group)
## # A tibble: 3 × 2
##   group             n
##   <chr>         <int>
## 1 Agent            10
## 2 Object_fixed      2
## 3 Object_random     2
p_from_text <- function(p_text) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("<", "", as.character(p_text))))
}

compare_pair <- function(group1, group2) {
  d2 <- expl_dat %>%
    filter(group %in% c(group1, group2)) %>%
    mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = c(group1, group2))) %>%
    droplevels()

  same <- gam(
    causal_rating ~
      group_f +
      s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) +
      s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
    data = d2,
    method = "ML"
  )

  diff <- gam(
    causal_rating ~
      group_f +
      s(delay_ms, by = group_f, k = k_delay) +
      s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
    data = d2,
    method = "ML"
  )

  cmp <- compareML(same, diff, print.output = FALSE)
  tibble(test = paste(group1, "vs.", group2),
         score_difference = as.numeric(cmp$table$Difference[2]),
         df = as.numeric(cmp$table$Df[2]),
         p = p_from_text(cmp$table$p.value[2]))
}

bind_rows(
  compare_pair("Agent", "Object_fixed"),
  compare_pair("Agent", "Object_random"),
  compare_pair("Object_fixed", "Object_random")
) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

## 3 Object_fixed vs. Object_random             5.22    -2 NA     NA
expl_dat$group_f <- factor(expl_dat$group, levels = c("Agent", "Object_fixed", "Object_random"))

model_groups <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    group_f +
    s(delay_ms, by = group_f, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = expl_dat,
  method = "REML"
)
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(-1000, 1000, length.out = 300),
  group_f = levels(expl_dat$group_f),
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)
newdat$group_f <- factor(newdat$group_f, levels = levels(expl_dat$group_f), ordered = is.ordered(expl_dat$group_f))
if (is.ordered(newdat$group_f)) contrasts(newdat$group_f) <- "contr.treatment"

pred <- predict(model_groups, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(delay_ms,participant)")
newdat$fit <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)

obs <- expl_dat %>%
  group_by(group_f, delay_ms) %>%
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(causal_rating), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(newdat, aes(x = delay_ms, y = fit, color = group_f, fill = group_f)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = delay_ms, y = mean_rating, color = group_f),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_groups, labels = labels_groups) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_groups, labels = labels_groups) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Temporal delay (ms)", y = "Causal judgment", color = NULL, fill = NULL,
